brief:
Political analyst Iiad al-Qara said Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is deploying military escalation in Gaza and mutual threats with Iran to evade domestic crises and delay political accountability, Shehab Wire reported. Al-Qara warned that Netanyahu's attempts to widen the confrontation risk pushing the region toward war.

The analyst characterized the military posturing as a tool for sidestepping internal political pressures facing Netanyahu's government.

title: Netanyahu uses Gaza escalation to escape domestic crisis, analyst warns
